_comment: Generic, non-private checks for the trading-skill text. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Prompts are used only in optional live mode and contain no positions or decision logs.

cases.description: reads carry a decision status incl. insufficient data
touch and terminal probabilities kept separate
archived rows used at knowledge time, not stamp
no blanket claim of a proven or guaranteed edge
forced flow read from a feed, never inferred
cases.prompt: Open interest fell 3% in the last hour while price dropped 1.5%. Were longs liquidated?

cases.description: states insufficient data rather than a manufactured number
cases.prompt: A new signal fired 6 times in 60 days and the average next-hour return was -35 bp. Is this an edge?
